title: Tencent Leases 100,000 Nvidia GPUs from Oracle to Bypass China Gaps

tickers.name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited American Depositary Shares, each represents eight Ordinary Shares

summary:
ByteDance and Alibaba are seeking expansive lease agreements for overseas data centers to resolve acute shortages of high end computing power within China. Tencent has already signed a contract with Oracle to lease 100,000 GPUs across Southeast Asia to access Nvidia's B300 chips, which are unavailable domestically. These arrangements allow Chinese technology giants to maintain AI development despite an uphill battle to reduce the sector's overall dependency on Nvidia hardware.

The shift toward foreign compute leases comes as top end chips flow to PRC firms while US companies fight for priority access to a limited global supply. The Wall Street Journal reports that the desperation for this processing power is upending Silicon Valley as companies scramble to secure the hardware necessary for the AI boom. This offshore strategy serves as a critical workaround for Chinese firms to obtain cutting edge hardware that they cannot secure at home.
